title: Trump’s Fixation on Arctic Ships Led to Billions in No-Bid Contracts
summary: The president decided to buy 11 polar icebreakers after a game of golf with Finland’s president. Experts say it’s far from clear the United States needs so many.

title: Justice Dept. Subpoenas Times Freelancer in Effort to Identify Sources
summary: A previously undisclosed subpoena, involving reporting on a failed SEAL Team 6 mission in North Korea, reflects the government’s expanding campaign to investigate leaks of secrets.

title: Scope of Hacks on U.S. Water Supply Widens as Evidence Points to Iran
summary: Michigan and Minnesota are among at least seven states coping with cyberattacks aimed at disrupting water systems nationwide.

title: Iran Plotted Wider War With Help of Its Proxies
summary: During a fleeting truce, Iranians covertly devised a plan to raise the war’s costs for President Trump if U.S. forces attacked anew.

title: Evidence Indicates U.S. Dropped Bomb on Residential Area in Iran, Killing 3 Civilians
summary: The weapon, one of the largest in the U.S.’s arsenal, struck a house in a heavily populated area, according to a Times analysis.

title: Kuwait Says It Downed Iranian Drones as Mideast Braces for Possible Escalation
summary: The wave of strikes came as President Trump threatened to intensify the American campaign against Iran. U.S. embassies in the region warned of the “potential for unforeseen escalation.”

title: Fact-Checking Trump’s Claims About the Effect of the Iran War on Oil Prices, Munitions and More
summary: The president misleadingly blamed the Biden administration’s weapons transfers to Ukraine for current concerns over munitions stockpiles, among other claims about the Iran war.

title: She Voted for a Justice Who Overturned Roe. Now it Haunts Her on the Trail.
summary: Senator Susan Collins, who supports abortion rights, endorsed Brett Kavanaugh’s nomination for the Supreme Court. It has emerged as a major issue in her campaign for re-election.

title: How 50,000 Migrants Surged Into Ceuta, a Spanish Exclave Near Morocco
summary: On Thursday, tens of thousands of Moroccans broke into Ceuta, a Spanish territory that neighbors Morocco. By Friday evening, most of them had left, hungry and disappointed.

title: Spain Installs Floating Barrier in Ceuta After Influx of Migrants
summary: Most of those who came to the territory, a Spanish exclave in Africa, have returned across the border to Morocco. At least 67 people died trying to enter, the authorities said.

title: Anthony Bourdain’s Wild Summers Still Echo in Provincetown
summary: As a new film evokes his coming-of-age in this bohemian Cape Cod town, Pete Wells goes looking for the people and restaurants that shaped him.

title: Meet the Americans Who Can’t Afford Hair Cuts or Toilet Paper
summary: Millions of Americans struggle in sometimes unimaginable ways, and Trump’s cuts in food stamps and other benefits are now making life even more precarious.

title: The Working Class Is Fleeing Trump
summary: Democrats have an anger problem. Republicans have a Trump problem.

title: Making Rounds
summary: Errands get us out of our homes and into the world, on missions providing both serendipity and satisfaction.
